title: Your account
subtitle: Everything Healthy360 needs before your first order, and everything you can change afterwards.

checklist.title: Finish setting up
checklist.subtitle: A few things are still needed. You can do them in any order.
checklist.cannotActivate: A few required steps are still outstanding.
checklist.outstanding_one: {{count}} required step to go. You can do it whenever suits you.
checklist.outstanding_other: {{count}} required steps to go. You can do them in any order.

verify_email.title: Confirm your email address
verify_email.body: We use it for order confirmations and for signing you in.

verify_phone.title: Confirm your mobile number
verify_phone.body: So a driver can reach you on the day.

add_address.title: Add a delivery address
add_address.body: Choose the area you are in — we only deliver to areas on the list.

dietary_profile.title: Tell us what you cannot eat
dietary_profile.body: Allergies and dietary needs, so meals can be filtered for you.

consents.title: Review your permissions
consents.body: What you agree to, and what you can decline.

marketing.title: Offers and updates
marketing.subtitle: Entirely up to you. Nothing here affects your orders or your account.
marketing.note: You can change these at any time, and stopping them takes effect immediately.
marketing.saveFailed: That change was not saved. Try again.

contacts.title: Email and phone
contacts.subtitle: Where we reach you. Each one is confirmed with a code before we use it.
contacts.removeBody: {{contact}} will no longer be used for anything.
contacts.loginEmailNote: This is the address you sign in with, so it cannot be removed here.
contacts.emptyBody: Add an address or a number so we can reach you.

phone.title: Your mobile number
phone.subtitle: We send a short code to confirm it, then use it only for deliveries.
phone.pendingBody: This number is on your account but has not been confirmed yet.
phone.countryHint: The dialling code goes in front of your number.
phone.numberHint: Without the country code. A leading zero is fine — we take it off.

errors.tooShort: That is too short to be a mobile number.
errors.tooLong: That is too long to be a mobile number.

phone.duplicateTitle: That number is already on your account
phone.duplicateBody: There is nothing to add. If it is not confirmed yet, ask for a code from the number shown above.
phone.verifiedBody: A driver can now reach you on it. We will not use it for anything else without asking.
phone.noNumberBody: There is no mobile number on your account yet.
phone.otpFallback: That did not work. Check your connection and try again.

addresses.title: Delivery addresses
addresses.subtitle: Where your orders go.
addresses.removeBody: “{{label}}” will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
addresses.areaHint: Only areas we deliver to are listed.
addresses.coverageBody: We serve {{area}}, but not every kitchen delivers to every area. You will see which ones do when you order.
addresses.noAreasBody: The delivery areas could not be loaded, so an address cannot be saved yet.
addresses.notesHint: Anything that helps someone find you. Not part of the address.
addresses.emptyBody: Add one so we know where to deliver.
addresses.missingTitle: That address is no longer here
addresses.missingBody: It may have been removed, or the link may be out of date.

dietary.title: Allergies and diet
dietary.subtitle: This is the record everything else reads from — the meal builder and your plans both start here.
dietary.storeOfRecord: Changing this here changes it everywhere.
dietary.disclaimerContext: We filter meals against what you tell us here. Tell us everything that matters, and check the ingredients of anything you are unsure about.
dietary.hasAllergiesLabel: Do you have any allergies or intolerances?
dietary.unanswered: You have not answered this yet. Either answer is fine — we just need to know.
dietary.noneBody: We will record that you have none. You can change this whenever you like.
dietary.severityLabel: How strictly should we avoid it?
dietary.severityFor: {{allergen}} — how strictly should we avoid it?
dietary.severityHint: Only a declared allergy removes a meal outright.
dietary.dietsSubtitle: Vegetarian, halal, and anything else that shapes what you are shown.
dietary.dietsEmpty: Nothing chosen — you will be shown everything.
dietary.exclusionsSubtitle: Things you simply do not want, for reasons that are not an allergy.

consents.title: Permissions
consents.subtitle: What you have agreed to. You can change the optional ones whenever you like.
consents.emptyBody: No permissions have been published for your account.
consents.requiredNote: This one is needed to use Healthy360 at all.
consents.reconsentBody: You agreed to an earlier version. Read it again and agree if you are happy with it.
consents.ageGate: Confirm your age before agreeing to anything else.
consents.outstanding_one: {{count}} required permission still to agree to.
consents.outstanding_other: {{count}} required permissions still to agree to.

closure.title: Closing your account
closure.subtitle: Tell us why, choose how far it goes, and we will show you what is in the way.
closure.reasonHint: This helps us fix what pushed you away. It is not used to talk you out of it.
closure.noteHint: Optional. Deleted when the closure finishes.

reasons.dietary_needs_unmet: It does not meet my dietary needs
reasons.service_quality: The service was not good enough

marketing_opt_out.title: We stop emailing you, and nothing else changes
marketing_opt_out.body: Your orders, addresses and dietary profile stay exactly as they are. You can turn marketing back on whenever you like.

full.title: This deletes your account
full.body: Your contacts, addresses and dietary profile are destroyed and you are signed out. It cannot be undone.

reasonsWhy.orders_in_flight_one: 1 order has not been delivered yet.
reasonsWhy.orders_in_flight_other: {{count}} orders have not been delivered yet.
reasonsWhy.memberships_live_one: You still belong to 1 company account.
reasonsWhy.memberships_live_other: You still belong to {{count}} company accounts.
reasonsWhy.signatures_pending_one: 1 agreement is waiting for your signature.
reasonsWhy.signatures_pending_other: {{count}} agreements are waiting for your signature.
reasonsWhy.credit_memos_unsettled_one: 1 credit is recorded and not yet settled. It is settled by hand, and after closure there is no account to settle it against.
reasonsWhy.credit_memos_unsettled_other: {{count}} credits are recorded and not yet settled. They are settled by hand, and after closure there is no account to settle them against.
reasonsWhy.orders_module_absent: We could not check orders — that part of the system is absent.
reasonsWhy.subscriptions_module_absent: We could not check subscriptions — that part of the system is absent.
reasonsWhy.organisations_module_absent: We could not check company memberships — that part of the system is absent.
reasonsWhy.b2b_module_absent: We could not check business agreements — that part of the system is absent.
reasonsWhy.no_wallet_module: There is no wallet, so there is nothing to check.
reasonsWhy.no_payment_module: There are no saved payment methods, so there is nothing to check.

closure.blockedBody: Deal with these first, then come back. We will re-check when you do.
closure.acknowledge_one: I have read the note above and want to continue
closure.acknowledge_other: I have read the {{count}} notes above and want to continue

retained.orders_anonymised: Your orders keep their amounts, dates and delivery area for accounting. The street address on them is redacted.
retained.credit_memos: Any recorded credit is kept so it can still be settled.
retained.contact_suppression: A one-way fingerprint of your email and phone, so "never contact me again" keeps working after the address itself is gone.
retained.closure_tombstone: A record that this account was closed, and when. It holds no readable contact details.

closure.irreversibleTitle: This is the point of no return
closure.irreversibleBody: Entering the code closes the account, destroys your contacts, addresses and dietary profile, and signs you out.
closure.noChallenge: No code has been sent yet. Go back and start the closure again.
closure.verifyFailed: We could not confirm that code.
closure.closedBody: Everything we could delete has been deleted.
closure.signedOutNote: You have been signed out. This device no longer holds a session.
closure.optOutDoneBody: We will not send you marketing again. Your account and everything in it is untouched.
